subject: Your 28-day date streak is ready
preview_text: You've been planning together for a month. Here's what you've built so far – and what's waiting.
body_paragraphs: You've been using SoulPlan for 28 days. That's a month of showing up for your relationship – even when life got busy. And here's the thing: couples who make it this far plan 4x more dates than those who don't. You're not just using an app. You're building a habit that keeps the spark alive without the planning fatigue.

Look back at your Memory Timeline for a second. Those photos, those notes – they're not just memories. They're proof that you're investing in something real. Every date, every 'thought of you tonight' moment from your partner, every streak you've kept going (or paused with a no-shame freeze) – it all adds up. You're not running out of ideas anymore. You're running on momentum.

That's why Tonight's Date is still sitting on your home screen, waiting for your next move. One tap on a mood – cozy, adventurous, playful, healing – and tonight is planned in 30 seconds. No scrolling, no debating, no fatigue. Just a moment that says 'I see you, and I'm here.' And if you want to surprise them, your Wishlist is full of ideas the AI has been saving just for this.

Open SoulPlan now and tap Tonight's Date. Let the app do the planning – you just show up. P.S. Your Anniversary Jar is about to fire a reminder for an important date. Don't let it slip – check it today.
